Membership starts 01.01.2027 with a 12-month initial term (through 31.12.2027); to avoid automatic continuation, a written cancellation must reach the provider by one month before that end date, i.e. by 2027-11-30, after which the contract continues unbefristet with 1-month rolling notice.

The printed IBAN (DE45 3705 0198 0005 5242 40) is a well-formed German IBAN, but no payment is due now (training is free until 01.01.2027); verify the payee name shown by your bank before any future direct debit or transfer to this account.
